summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a routine Form 6-K attaching a press release dated November 3, 2026, disclosing the per-share amount of its previously announced second interim scrip dividend for fiscal 2026, an aggregate EUR 600 million distribution. The dividend per share is EUR 0.8350 on shares of EUR 0.01 nominal value. Shareholders may elect shares or cash, with shares as the default absent an election during the election period; banks and brokers may apply their contractual default. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural overhang beyond ordinary scrip mechanics is disclosed; no special-situations event.
